title: EntailLLM: Verifying Agent-Generated Vulnerability Discovery Paths with Domain Knowledge via Logic Programming
abstract: arXiv:2608.01763v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language model agents are increasingly used to analyze potential software vulnerabilities, but their outputs can silently violate domain knowledge, limiting their reliability in safety-critical settings such as medical devices. Prior work either treats that output as a prediction to be scored or constrains it to walks within a single knowledge graph; neither checks whether reasoning over a binary is entailed by an independent body of domain knowledge. We present EntailLLM, a framework that includes a specialized LLM agent and a validation mechanism. The agent proposes a traversal path of the function call graph for a vulnerability, which is checked against a separate knowledge graph and a logic program by an entailment procedure under annotated logic. We evaluate EntailLLM by examining six specialized agents across three CWE classes, and eight binaries varying in size from 405 to 12,696 functions. The agents improve poole

translated_title: EntailLLM：基于逻辑编程利用领域知识验证智能体生成的漏洞发现路径
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型智能体正被越来越多地用于分析潜在的软件漏洞，但其输出可能会悄然违反领域知识，从而限制了其在医疗器械等安全关键场景中的可靠性。以往的工作要么将该输出视为需要评分的预测，要么将其约束在单一知识图谱内的游走路径上；两者都无法检查针对二进制文件的推理是否被一个独立的领域知识体系所蕴含。我们提出了EntailLLM，这是一个包含专门LLM智能体和验证机制的框架。该智能体针对某一漏洞提出函数调用图的遍历路径，该路径通过标注逻辑下的蕴含推导程序，与一个独立的知识图谱和逻辑程序进行核对验证。我们通过检查六个专门智能体在三个CWE类别上的表现来评估EntailLLM，并使用了函数数量从405到12,696不等的八个二进制文件。这些智能体提升了……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: EntailLLM框架让专门的LLM智能体提出二进制漏洞的函数调用图遍历路径，并通过标注逻辑下的蕴含推导将其与独立的领域知识图谱和逻辑程序进行验证，从而提升安全关键场景中漏洞分析的可靠性。
